# Cultural Imprint Engine (CIE)

Canonical website: https://crown-thrive-os.vercel.app/cie
Live Lab: https://crown-thrive-os.vercel.app/cie/lab
Use Cases: https://crown-thrive-os.vercel.app/cie/use-cases

Production API: https://uipojzbnnfifsbkivxoh.supabase.co/functions/v1/cie-api
Production MCP: https://uipojzbnnfifsbkivxoh.supabase.co/functions/v1/cie-mcp

Framework release: 4.1.0-commercial
Website release: 1.1
Commercial state: LIVE_SELLABLE

CIE is CrownThrive's cultural identity and ecosystem architecture framework. It structures identity, narrative, audience, voice, representation constraints, cultural commitments and ecosystem routing across products, media, commerce, advertising, licensing, analytics and AI.

CIE becomes useful when identity decisions multiply across channels, brands, teams, agencies, AI systems, sponsors, licensees, affiliates, ads, and distribution partners. It is not merely a style guide. It creates a machine-usable imprint object that can carry identity, audience, voice, goals, guardrails, rights context, channel rules, and evidence expectations into downstream execution.

The public CIE Live Lab executes a real deterministic Vercel scenario runner. It returns a run ID, timestamp, server duration, imprint classification, six public lens scores, drift findings, ecosystem route, commercial-fit recommendation, PentaAds projection, and explicit authority boundaries. The demo runner uses no protected CrownThrive calibration, provider credentials, ad-spend authority, payment authority, or third-party provider writes.

Five imprint families: institutional, corridor, platform, media/channel, and brand/campaign.
Six public lenses: identity depth, cultural contribution, ecosystem gravity, economic utility, scalability + longevity, and imprint power.

Commercial tiers: Operator $299, Studio $799, Agency $2,499, Institutional $4,999, Enterprise $7,500. API/MCP and the PentaAds bridge begin at Studio. Conditional resale, sublicensing, white-label and OEM rights require the appropriate signed CrownThrive addendum.
